title: Transpose a Matrix (stdin)
hints: Parse each line into `[Int]` and skip empty lines.
Column `c` of the input becomes row `c` of the output.
jsBridge: Parse rows with `split` + `compactMap(Int.init)`, then transpose with `(0..<cols).map { c in rows.map { $0[c] } }`, the same nested-map idiom as in JS.

compass.q: JS `rows[0].map((_, c) => rows.map(r => r[c]))`. Is the Swift version any different?
What happens with ragged rows? Where should validation happen?
Nested `map` vs a preallocated `[[Int]](repeating:count:)` with index writes: which is faster?
Charts often need data transposed (series vs categories). Where have you done that?
